      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _D.S.H1723_, Aug 28, 2026, 1/5: "Too many features behind a paywall, app is barely usable now."
            2. _RML6635_, Aug 28, 2026, 2/5: "After using for about 5 years it suddenly got glitchy and kept losing my prior days data. Lost years worth of it. Support kept telling me to do the same things I had already done over and over and seemed to be blind to the idea that maybe I wasn’t stupid and there actually was a problem. I was a system administrator for many years, I understand how to reset devices, remove and reload software, and I understand logging in with two different accounts yields different results. 🙄 It worked great in the past but not worth the high blood pressure now and I’ll likely lose the last 5 months of my premium subscription."
